current.text: He was traded from Charlotte to Chicago.
He is a bench guard in Chicago. The bench order is Tre Jones as sixth man, then Isaac Okoro, Jalen Smith and Buddy Hield.
His contract is guaranteed, mostly as matching salary.
Do not draft him. Even if he starts, he is not an automatic add. He is only a three-point streamer.

durable.text: His three-point attempt rate stays steady (67 and 65), but his three-point percentage fell from 39 to 37 to 35.
He is no longer an elite three-point shooter, and he adds little in the other categories.

tags.name: age decline watch
tags.detail: Age 33, three-point percentage down three seasons in a row

note: He is not draftable in our league. Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD and rank him 304 and 271, far outside the 144 players we draft. Projections of 1.2 to 1.8 threes and 5 to 9 points per game make him a short-term three-point streamer at most. Early in the season, check whether he gets real minutes behind Tre Jones and whether a buyout happens.
